Approved findings

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

elorian decoycount · human annotation: The DecoyCount creator article describes a decoy taxonomy fixed before image collection, model-based difficulty screening, and independent blind counting followed by disagreement adjudication and removal of ambiguous, occluded or specialist-dependent items.

Permanent record ID: candidate.next12.decoycount.curation.v2

  • These are the creator’s collection/review procedures, not new worker-performance measurements or an independent recount.
  • The article explicitly identifies a Mercor partnership; no additional recruitment, payment or per-worker responsibility is inferred.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

elorian decoycount · documents: DecoyCount’s format document discloses 121 potentially stale multi-hop answers in the internal evaluated bank after underlying counts changed, and states that the standalone evaluator does not automatically exclude those items.

Permanent record ID: candidate.next12.decoycount.derived-answer-limit.v2

  • The disclosure does not establish that all 121 are wrong or certify the remaining labels. It is not silently mapped to 121 confirmed errors in the current 1,586-task preview.
  • The item-level quality metadata and private historical records were not accessed.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

elorian decoycount · evaluates: The DecoyCount format document defines exact-match integer accuracy with API/parsing failures retained in the denominator, a registered-decoy hit rate for neutral/cued counting, and a paired cued-minus-neutral accuracy gap.

Permanent record ID: candidate.next12.decoycount.metrics.v3

  • The gap is compared for the same checkpoint, release and settings. A positive gap may also reflect disambiguation and does not uniquely isolate all reasoning errors.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

elorian decoycount · benchmark task: DecoyCount supplies neutral, alignment-cued and multi-hop prompt conditions; for neutral versus cued prompts the image and correct count stay fixed while the cue names the intended counting rule.

Permanent record ID: candidate.next12.decoycount.paired-prompts.v3

  • Multi-hop can add scenario context and a secondary image, while the article retains the instruction to return an integer. These prompt conditions remain within one benchmark family.

Approved evidence · As of 12 Nov 2026

elorian decoycount · dataset size: The DecoyCount v6 release notes describe 1,586 retained tasks, 2,108 registered decoys and 2,369 images, comprising 1,586 primary and 783 secondary images; they distinguish this preview from the paper’s original 1,660-task bank.

Permanent record ID: candidate.next12.decoycount.release-units.v3

  • The creator documents describe 25 earlier withdrawals and 49 additional task-level exclusions. These source-release exclusions do not remove the retained logical benchmark family.
  • The blog describes rescored current-release results, while current repository documents warn that historical paper scores are not reruns on this release; no numerical performance claim is resolved here.
